info.name: KHR_RENDERER_AMBIENT_LIGHT
info.comment: Local copy of the ANARI registry extension. Identical to the registry version except that ambientRadiance defaults to 1.0 (the value Renderer.cpp actually uses) instead of the registry's 0.

parameters.name: ambientRadiance
parameters.description: the amount of light emitted by a point on the ambient light source in a direction, in W/sr/m^2 (device default 1.0 overrides the registry default of 0)
